decisions: Scope: baseline unclassified_modules + misplaced_modules minus open-PR files and tests/quality, tests/fixtures, tests/lifecycle (never-edit).
Protected test_architecture_* and *_lifecycle* modules: marker-only commit; never moved, even when they spawn processes from tests/unit.

e2e = module runs the installed CLI (ApmLifecycleRunner, apm_binary_path, apm_engine_command, packaged_sample, run_cli); component = tmp_path, CliRunner, real files, repo file reads, git, http; unit = pure logic with mocks only.
Modules mixing CliRunner and real-binary tests are classified e2e (module must be uniform).
